title: Tailor Based on Context
coreMove: Tailoring is disciplined fit: keep the PMBOK principle alive by changing approach, governance, and communication when context proves the inherited plan is wrong.

exampleSpecs.audience: project managers reviewing a missed release
exampleSpecs.stakes: find the one tailoring decision that failed under pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the scene reconstructs a missed tradeoff under schedule pressure

exampleSpecs.stakes: notice when a process has become too broad for the actual risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices her own process error mid-stream

exampleSpecs.stakes: make the tailoring decision legible in writing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a written memo carries the action

exampleSpecs.stakes: show how opposite approaches produce different outcomes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two named people face the same pressure with opposite tailoring moves

exampleSpecs.stakes: reframe consistency as fit rather than sameness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a peer gives a quotable reframe

exampleSpecs.audience: new project managers learning PMBOK principles
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn confusion about tailoring into a teachable comparison
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a learner's confusion becomes the teaching material
